//: Only what this repo needs checked: the Python under tools/ (the ABI gates)
and core/abitest/ (Tier-C conformance). The repo has no pyproject.toml — the
Python here is build tooling, not a package, so the search paths are declared
abi_conformance_test.py inserts tools/ onto sys.path at runtime so the gates
and the tests share one header parser (tools/abi_symbols.py) and cannot drift
from each other. This tells the type checker the same thing.
